natural_body: 40% discount lifts acquisition and revenue but cuts 30-day retention 12%; use selectively.

first.rationale: I intend to test onboarding simplification because both onboarding completion and activation have declined, and prior evidence indicates that shorter onboarding and fewer signup requirements improved early adoption. I would verify the onboarding result and the pricing tradeoff before committing: competitor pricing creates urgency, but the inherited pricing evidence indicates a material 30-day retention cost that could undermine sustainable qualified revenue.
